jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Data Quality Manager, the day typically involves close collaboration with business stakeholders, data stewards, and engineering teams in data domains to discover and co-create data quality expectations. The role focuses on translating data governance strategy into scalable frameworks and embedding data quality and observability into processes and systems. Efforts also include standardizing reusable capabilities, strengthening metadata and governance practices, and ensuring consistent operationalization across the organization. Define and use mechanisms to measure impact through business value such as efficiency gains and reduced data risks, with insights regularly shared with senior leadership to support strategic decision-making.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Execution of enterprise data quality strategy through translation of business objectives into scalable architectures, roadmaps, and implementation patterns
* Definition of frameworks for measuring financial and operational impact, including cost of poor data quality (COPDQ), efficiency gains, and revenue enablement
* Standardization of reusable data quality capabilities and integration of domain terminologies and semantic layers with quality rules and observability metrics
* Establishment of governance structures, development of organizational capabilities, and definition of audit and assurance KPIs for enterprise reporting
* Collaboration with business stakeholders, data stewards, and engineers to define and refine data quality requirements
* Development and maintenance of a Data Quality Playbook alongside communication of insights to senior leadership to support strategic decision-making

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science; for India, additional MBA from a Tier-1 institution with 10 years of experience in data governance
* Long-standing professional experience in data quality, data governance, or related data management fields within complex data environments including multiple ERP, CRM, OEM systems, and data lake architectures
* Strong expertise in data quality frameworks, metadata management, data lineage, and data catalogs, with advanced SQL proficiency and experience in modern data architectures (data lakehouse, data mesh, data fabric, streaming architectures)
* Experience in developing data quality business cases, prioritizing investments, and demonstrating sustained ROI from data quality programs
* Strong stakeholder management, change management, and cross-functional leadership capabilities
* Excellent English proficiency; certifications in data governance or data quality (e.g., DAMA CDMP) and familiarity with ISO standards, SAP data extraction methods, and Salesforce APIs considered a plus

About the Team

In our Business Functions we enable our organization to reach their targets by providing best-in 
class services and solutions in the areas of IT, HR, Finance, Real Estate, Strategy & Technology and more.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.occupation: Working Student (d/f/m) Mission Systems (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support our Computer Vision Team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) Mission Systems

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of our Computer Vision team? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: Juli 2026
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling within Germany is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Support for training of vision AI models.
- Benchmarking and optimization.
- Investigate state of the art vision technologies.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) within Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or a similar field of studies.
- Programming skills in Python are mandatory.
- Programming skills in C/C++ or Java is desirable.
- Drone piloting licence A1/A3 would be desirable.
- Fluent in German or English.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

Imagine leading the global operational heartbeat of EQS across Substations worldwide — where your work directly shapes how Quality, Environment, Health & Safety, Product Safety, and Sustainability are governed every single day. 

As EQS Operations Manager (f/m/d), you will run and continuously improve the global operating cadence — weekly, monthly, and quarterly — translating strategy into disciplined, practical execution across regions with different maturity levels and real operational pressure. You will collaborate closely with regional EQS leads, project and factory teams, Operational Excellence, Supplier Quality Management, and senior business leadership, acting as the key operational interface that keeps accountability sharp and escalation consistent. This is a role where your analytical rigour, structured governance mindset, and genuine commitment to prevention and recurrence reduction will make a lasting difference across a complex, international organisation.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Lead global EQS governance by running and evolving the global operating cadence for Substations covering QM/NCC, EHS, Product Safety, and Sustainability, reviewing risks and deviations across regions and projects to ensure early identification and consistent escalation
* Drive quality and non-conformance outcomes ensuring transparent oversight of Non-Conformance Costs, challenge the quality of Root Cause Analyses and Corrective and Preventive Actions, and keep a sharp focus on preventing recurrence across the organisation
* Govern EHS and Product Safety risks, overseeing high-risk exposures and incidents, ensuring cross-regional learning, effective preventive actions, and systematic lifecycle tracking of Product Safety risks from identification through to closure
* Apply a maturity-based operating model calibrating your support to where each region is: increase structure and guidance where maturity is low, and enable autonomy where teams are ready - while coaching and challenging regional EQS leads through structured reviews and best-practice sharing
* Partner across the business to drive action; collaborating with Operational Excellence, Supplier Quality Management, and Substations leadership to decide which issues require escalation, business action, or leadership attention, ensuring nothing falls through the gaps

What You Bring

* A university degree in engineering, a technical or business discipline, or comparable hands-on professional experience in complex operational environments
* Multiple years of experience across Quality, EHS, Product Safety, and/or Sustainability with a strong track record of running governance systems and operating models, not just subject-matter expertise
* Experience working across regions, projects, factories, or execution units at different maturity levels, combined with a solid grasp of reactive and preventive methodologies such as NCC management, RCA/8D, risk management, audits, and incident investigation

jobs.description:
Full-Stack Software Developer (m/f/d): TETTRIX project

Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Center (SDMC) at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as soon as possible:

Full-Stack Software Developer (m/f/d): TETTRIX project

(Full-Time / Part-Time)

Location: Frankfurt
Employment scope: Full-Time / Part-Time options are available
Type of contract: Temporary, initially limited to 2 years
Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E11- E13

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.

The position is within the Geobiodiversity Information and Data Management team of the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Centre and contributes to a project funded by the European Union, TETTRIX – TETTRIs neXt level for the taxonomy of tomorrow. The team works at the interface of biodiversity informatics, ecological modelling, and data management, focusing on integrating, analysing, and making biodiversity data accessible for research and conservation. The TETTRIX project aims to strengthen taxonomic capacity for biodiversity research by developing, validating, and scaling innovative tools, workflows, services, and training pathways, while addressing critical knowledge and capacity gaps across Europe. Within the TETTRIX project, the position will develop a web-based, open-access biodiversity mapping and Species Distribution Modelling (SDM) platform that enables reproducible data and modelling workflows and transforms biodiversity data into actionable knowledge for biodiversity monitoring and conservation. The role combines full-stack software development with biodiversity data integration and close collaboration with researchers and technical partners.

Your tasks

- Develop the platform's web application end-to-end: SPA frontend (interactive map, species/variable selection, model-run monitoring) and REST API backend.
- Integrate the application with the PostgreSQL/PostGIS metadata layer and the AWS-side batch and data-lake services.
- Co-design and implement the data infrastructure of the Open Modular SDM Platform, including a columnar lakehouse (Parquet, DuckDB, Dask on AWS Batch) covering the full GBIF and OBIS datasets.
- Develop and operate the hybrid infrastructure, integrating AWS-based services with the institute's internal serving layer (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, map tiles and APIs), and coordinate the associated technical tasks.
- Implement map-tile serving, caching and optimise frontend performance.
- Set up and maintain CI/CD, automated tests and containerised deployment (Docker) in cooperation with central IT.
- Participate in project and team meetings and coordinate closely with the scientific team on a day-to-day basis.

Your profile

- Degree in Computer Science or comparable practical experience.
- Solid skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern framework (React, Vue or similar).
- Backend experience in Python (e.g. FastAPI/Flask) or Node.js; sound REST API design.
- Experience with SQL/PostgreSQL; PostGIS and web-mapping libraries (MapLibre GL, Leaflet, OpenLayers) are a strong plus.
- Experience with cloud-based data infrastructure, particularly AWS services (S3, Batch).
- Knowledge of columnar data storage and lakehouse technologies (Parquet, DuckDB, Dask).
- Experience with data pipelines, batch processing and the integration of large-scale datasets.
- Knowledge of hybrid infrastructure architectures and the integration of cloud-based and on-premises services.
- Experience with Docker, Git and CI/CD.
- Very good command of English.
- Willingness to work on site in Frankfurt (up to 40% remote work is possible).

Desirable skills

- Familiarity with open-access biodiversity databases such as the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) and the Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS), Darwin Core standards, and biodiversity data life cycles
- Familiarity with species distribution modelling and associated statistical/machine-learning approaches (e.g. GLM/GAM, MaxEnt, Random Forest)
- A track record in scientific publications, reproducible scientific computing, or open-source projects

We offer

- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations
- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution
- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan

Senckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, age, gender, ethnic or cultural origin, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or and ideology, sexual orientation and identity or disability. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.

How to apply?

Please upload your application (letter of motivation, CV, relevantcertificates and references, if available) electronically as a single PDF by 15. November2026.

Contact

Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung
Senckenberganlage 25
60325 Frankfurt am Main

For specific questions about this role, please contact Dr. Hanieh Saeediat hanieh.saeedi@senckenberg.de
